comments: Registered as one bank: the frame's feet (outer edges of the two foot blocks) share one baseline and the pivot x is their centre, not the crop centre; the roof overhangs a few source pixels on the right.
One scale for the whole bank; the stage stamps the bottom-centre at the bell post's foot.

A reviewed ink grade keeps the weathered timber and the contour brown: the snap sent the olive-brown flecks (69793e) to a brown (684629) and the dark-green outline ink (182414) to a dark brown (331a0c); both are admitted shared inks, no pixel moves or is added.
geometry: The Bell post stands on a free tile west of the well, foot at the post point; art never sets a hitbox.
mapping_basis: Visual review of the delivered sheet and its measured crops, 2026-10-18. Reading order equals the request order: the straight bell is idle-0; the swings right 28, left 28, right 18, left 18, right 10 and left 6 degrees are ring-0..5 (a damped swing). The timber frame and slate cap are the same drawing in every cell.

pieces.label: idle-0: the bell hangs straight, rope vertical.
pieces.name: idle-0

pieces.label: ring-0: bell swung right about 28 degrees, clapper and rope trail left.
pieces.name: ring-0

pieces.label: ring-1: bell swung left about 28 degrees, clapper and rope trail right.
pieces.name: ring-1

pieces.label: ring-2: bell swung right about 18 degrees.
pieces.name: ring-2

pieces.label: ring-3: bell swung left about 18 degrees.
pieces.name: ring-3

pieces.label: ring-4: bell swung right about 10 degrees.
pieces.name: ring-4

pieces.label: ring-5: bell swung left about 6 degrees, nearly still.
pieces.name: ring-5

size_basis: native canvas 24x36, anchor bottom-centre (12,36); stage 384x224 at 16 px per tile; a knight is 16x24 in this town; the bell frame is about 1.5 knights tall.
timing: idle 12; ring 6x4 ticks (30 Hz). Art never sets a hitbox.
